correctness.rationale: The forced image-adjacency event is partitioned into one double-fixed-loop case, c_i chain cases and n-2-c_i disjoint-path cases, each with probability 1/[n(n-1)]. Contraction is bijective to uniform permutations on n-2 blocks. Marked cycle means 1/m and (h-1)/[m(m-1)] yield explicit conditional cycle-generating polynomials, whose coefficients give the stated local law and hence its aggregate. The standalone exact checker passed 2688 comparisons, including exhaustive n=4,...,9 enumeration; the unrestricted n proof is algebraic.

originality.rationale: No inspected primary source or matching published mathematical claim covers the complete positionwise and cycle-length-resolved covariance. The marginal-equidistribution theorem of Diaconis–Evans–Graham cannot transfer cycle structure; the Mansour–Shattuck joint theorem counts cycle-notation successions and the total cycle number, and explicitly warns that its joint distributions with other statistics differ from those of one-line successions. An earlier fixed-point/succession covariance calculation exactly covers the j=1 positionwise coefficient, which is excluded from the claimed novel contribution. The j=2, n-1, n coefficients and the exact vanishing for all intermediate lengths remain unimplicated by inspected sources. Historical cycle-index coverage is a residual risk, not an assertion of proven global uniqueness.
residual_risks: General multivariate cycle-index formulas for successions may imply the identity implicitly in less readily searchable historical literature, including older combinatorial enumerations.

value.rationale: The pair of statistics is natural: increasing successions are a local shuffle diagnostic, and cycle lengths record global orbit structure. The all-n identity completely identifies its linear coupling with the full cycle-type vector, giving exact orthogonality to every intermediate length j=3,...,n-2 and a sharp endpoint/interior mechanism; even the total cycle covariance is 1/n^2 from cancellation of larger terms. The new remaining length coefficients are not inferred from the prior fixed-point calculation and may guide joint shuffling/structural diagnostics. No downstream theorem is required for the motivation of this complete natural classification.
